name: Triangulation of Valley Surfaces
definition: A procedure to triangulate the point cloud representing a connected surface graph created by the extraction algorithm, using local Delaunay triangles and specific handling for non-manifold regions bounded by crease and degenerate lines.
summary: Triangulation of Valley Surfaces converts point clouds into watertight meshes by separately handling non-manifold ribbons from manifold parts, ensuring topological correctness where standard methods fail.
